## Author checklist / Lista de autoría

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits.
- [ ] El título sigue Conventional Commits.
- [ ] The branch includes the issue number and uses kebab-case.
- [ ] La rama incluye el issue y usa kebab-case.
- [ ] Public TypeScript/JSON/API names use `camelCase`; React components and types use `PascalCase`.
- [ ] PostgreSQL identifiers use `snake_case`.
- [ ] Visible text is available in English and Spanish through i18n.
- [ ] El texto visible está en inglés y español mediante i18n.
- [ ] Keyboard and accessibility behavior was preserved or tested.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, copied official pages, logos, or diagrams are included.
- [ ] Documentation and migrations are included for public-interface changes.
- [ ] I have authority to license every contribution under the repository's applicable licence.

## Community track only / Solo pista comunitaria

- [ ] The track is intended to be permanently public under CC BY 4.0.
- [ ] La pista será pública permanentemente bajo CC BY 4.0.
- [ ] Authorship metadata is accurate and was not manipulated.
- [ ] I understand merge requires the maintainer label `status:approved`.
